national_news.title: PM Narendra Modi Holds Bilateral Talks with Uzbek President in Tashkent
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi held bilateral talks with Uzbekistan President Shavkat Mirziyoyev in Tashkent to strengthen multi-sectoral cooperation.
Key discussion areas included defence, digital connectivity, energy, medicine, agriculture, and mining of rare earth minerals and gold.
Bilateral trade between India and Uzbekistan has grown by 300% over the past decade, with both nations targeting to double the current $1 billion trade.

national_news.title: India Dispatches Emergency Humanitarian Aid and Rescue Teams to Nepal
bullets: The Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) coordinated the rescue of 108 Indian nationals following devastating flash floods in Nepal.
India dispatched a C-130J Hercules aircraft carrying 11 tonnes of assistance, an Indian Army tunnel rescue team, and forensic teams for sample analysis.
India has provided 68.5 tonnes of emergency relief material and sent equipment to install eight modular steel and Bailey bridges to restore connectivity.

national_news.title: National Sports Day 2026 Observed Across India on August 29
bullets: National Sports Day is celebrated annually on August 29 to mark the birth anniversary of hockey legend Major Dhyan Chand.
The 2026 nationwide campaign was conducted under the call 'Ek Ghanta Khel Ke Maidan Mein', focused on three pillars: Tribute, Play, and Move.
Budgetary allocation for the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports reached over ₹4,400 crore in Union Budget 2026-27, boosting schemes like Khelo India, TOPS, and KIRTI.

national_news.title: Ministry of Education Highlights A Decade of Progress in Higher Education Sector
bullets: Data from the All India Survey on Higher Education (AISHE) shows universities in India grew by 69.6% from 760 in 2014–15 to 1,289 in 2023–24, while colleges increased by 25.3% to 48,246.

Total higher education student enrolment rose by 31.5% to reach 4.50 crore in 2023–24, pushing the Gross Enrolment Ratio (GER) to 30% against the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020 target of 50% by 2035.
Female student enrolment grew by 42.2% over the decade, rising from 1.57 crore in 2014–15 to 2.24 crore in 2023–24.

national_news.title: FSSAI Issues Prohibition Order on Compounded Hing of Major Brands for Substandard Quality
bullets: The Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI), under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, issued a Prohibition of Sale order for Compounded Hing from Everest Food Products and LG Brand Unit.
Laboratory testing revealed tested Compounded Hing contained only 0–3% alcohol soluble extract, falling short of the mandatory 5% minimum required under FSS Regulations, 2011.
Raw Hing samples collected from LG Brand Unit contained 15% to 32% starch content, significantly violating the statutory ceiling limit of 1%.

national_news.title: National Sports Day Celebrated Across India Honoring Major Dhyan Chand
bullets: National Sports Day is celebrated annually on August 29 to commemorate the birth anniversary of hockey legend Major Dhyan Chand.
The event featured a nationwide campaign structured around three pillars—'Tribute, Play, and Move'—with the core call of 'Ek Ghanta Khel Ke Maidan Mein'.

Key initiatives strengthening India's sporting infrastructure include Khelo India, the Target Olympic Podium Scheme (TOPS), and KIRTI, supported by a ₹4,400+ crore budget allocation for the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports in 2026-27.

national_news.title: Finance Minister Highlights India's Investment Potential at Chicago Roundtable
bullets: Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman addressed a high-level Business Roundtable in Chicago, organized by the Consulate General of India and the US-India Strategic Partnership Forum (USISPF).

Highlighted India's Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI)—including Aadhaar, UPI, DigiLocker, ONDC, and India Stack—and emphasized the evolution of Global Capability Centres into global innovation hubs.
Promoted manufacturing opportunities under Atmanirbhar Bharat, iDEX, and Production Linked Incentive (PLI) schemes while pitching GIFT IFSC as an international financial hub.

national_news.title: Petroleum Ministry Clarifies Revised CBG Pricing Framework under GOBARdhan Scheme
bullets: The Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas clarified the revised Compressed Biogas (CBG) pricing under the GOBARdhan scheme, raising the producer procurement price from ₹1,478 to ₹2,110 per MMBtu.
The Government provides affordability support of ₹10 per kg of CBG (approx. ₹215 per MMBtu), bringing the effective procurement cost down to roughly ₹1,895 per MMBtu.

The net cost of CBG will be pooled across a domestic natural gas base 2.5 to 3 times larger than before, protecting CNG and household PNG consumers from material price hikes while ensuring viable plant operations.

national_news.title: Third Vande Bharat Express to Connect Jammu and Srinagar via Udhampur
bullets: Union Minister Dr. Jitendra Singh announced the upcoming launch of the third Vande Bharat Express between Jammu and Srinagar, featuring an approved halt at Udhampur.
The rail line expansion highlights major engineering feats in Jammu and Kashmir, including the world's highest railway bridge constructed over the Chenab River in Reasi district.
The expanded railway connectivity from Jammu to the Kashmir Valley aims to boost regional integration, passenger convenience, and tourism.

national_news.title: India and Argentina Hold 4th Joint Trade Committee Meeting to Expand Bilateral Ties
bullets: The 4th India-Argentina Joint Trade Committee (JTC) meeting was held in Buenos Aires, co-chaired by Indian Commerce Secretary Rajesh Agrawal and Argentina's Secretary for International Economic Relations Fernando Brun.

Argentina agreed to work on upgrading India from Annex II to Annex I in its pharmaceutical regulatory framework and progress technical talks on Sanitary and Phytosanitary (SPS) access for Indian agricultural products.

Bilateral trade crossed USD 6.5 billion in 2025 (making India Argentina's 5th largest trading partner), while India's KABIL completed Phase II drilling at its lithium exploration project in Catamarca, Argentina.

national_news.title: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY) Completes 12 Years
bullets: Launched on August 28, 2014, PMJDY completed 12 years as the world's largest financial inclusion initiative.
Key statistics include over 59 crore accounts opened, total deposits reaching ₹3.17 lakh crore, 78% rural/semi-urban coverage, 56% women beneficiaries, and over 41 crore RuPay cards issued.
Supported by the Jan Dhan-Aadhaar-Mobile (JAM) trinity, India's Financial Inclusion Index rose from 53.9 in 2018 to 67 in 2026.

bihar_news.title: Bihar to Modernise 31 BSRTC Bus Stands on Gujarat's GSRTC Model
bullets: The Bihar Government approved the redevelopment of 31 Bihar State Road Transport Corporation (BSRTC) bus stands under the Public-Private Partnership (PPP) model, replicating Gujarat’s GSRTC Bus Port framework.

The terminals will feature EV charging stations, modern workshops, Sewage Treatment Plants (STPs), Effluent Treatment Plants (ETPs), and commercial spaces housing 3,000–5,000 shops to generate recurring revenue for BSRTC.
Patna is designated to house the state's largest bus terminal, while Muzaffarpur will be developed as the primary transit hub for North Bihar.

bihar_news.title: SC Rules Higher Qualifications Cannot Override Prescribed Eligibility Criteria
bullets: A Supreme Court bench of Justices P.S. Narasimha and Alok Aradhe ruled that candidates with higher qualifications cannot claim appointment to posts with prescribed lower eligibility criteria.

The apex court observed that permitting overqualified candidates deprives genuinely eligible candidates who possess the prescribed minimum qualification, emphasizing strict adherence to advertised recruitment rules.
The judgment arose from a recruitment dispute under the Bihar Lab Technician Cadre Rules, 2014, regarding Diploma (DMLT) versus Bachelor (BMLT) qualification requirements.

bihar_news.title: Bihar CM Inaugurates ₹249-Crore Karbigahia-Mithapur Flyover in Patna
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary inaugurated the first phase of the Karbigahia-Mithapur flyover, constructed at a cost of ₹249 crore in Patna.
A 2.1-km elevated road from Mithapur to Sipara was also opened to the public as part of the broader Mithapur-Mahuli-Punpun project.
The infrastructure project connects the Mithapur bus stand with the Mithapur roundabout via Karbigahia, facilitating smoother travel towards Mahuli, Punpun, and Patna Railway Station.

bihar_news.title: NBCC and NHPC Sign MoU for Pan-India Infrastructure Projects
bullets: NBCC (India) Limited (Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs) signed an MoU with NHPC Limited (Ministry of Power) for pan-India execution of infrastructure projects.
Under the agreement, NBCC will provide Project Management Consultancy (PMC) services for NHPC's buildings, residential blocks, office complexes, and allied works on a deposit work basis.
The partnership combines NHPC's hydropower expertise with NBCC's project execution capabilities to deliver standardized, sustainable, and time-efficient infrastructure.

bihar_news.title: Danapur-Bengaluru Express Upgraded to Daily Service from September 1
bullets: Indian Railways announced that the Danapur (Bihar) to Bengaluru (Karnataka) Express train service will operate daily from September 1, replacing its limited-frequency run.
The enhanced frequency aims to support high passenger movement, particularly migrant workers, students, and families traveling between eastern and southern India ahead of the festive season.
The upgrade improves direct long-distance rail connectivity for Bihar, offering a lower-cost and sustainable travel option between Danapur and India's major IT and economic hub.
